title: Ananias and Sapphira
reflectionText: Peter's own words make the sin plain, and it was not that they kept part of the money. "While it remained, was it not your own?" What they died for was the lie — pretending to give all while holding part back — a lie, Peter said, to God and not to men. Sapphira was asked, and repeated the false amount. What is the difference between giving little and pretending to give much?
